title: Garlic-Sesame Shrimp Uramaki
description: Garlic-seared shrimp, avocado and toasted sesame in a rice-outside roll.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Heat neutral oil over medium heat, add minced garlic and stir briefly without browning it deeply.
Add shrimp and cook until opaque throughout; finish with soy sauce and sesame oil. Cool until just warm.
Spread rice onto half a nori sheet over a wrapped mat and dust with sesame. Flip, add cooked shrimp and avocado, then roll.
Slice eight pieces, moistening and wiping the blade between cuts.
notes: Sesame oil is best added at the end to preserve aroma.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Cook shrimp thoroughly until the flesh is opaque throughout.
